concerns.text: FR-012 requires applying Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR correction at a level denoted by the placeholder `[deferred]`. Without a concrete alpha (e.g., 0.05), the requirement is not measurable or verifiable.

SC-005 asks the report to state whether the observed sample size was sufficient to detect an effect size of 0.15 with `[deferred]` power. The missing numeric power target makes the success criterion unmeasurable.
